density.label: Density
density.hint: Compact tightens the spacing of rows and file lists.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Applies immediately, across the whole app.

launchMinimized.label: Start minimized
launchMinimized.hint: Opens the window minimized to the taskbar or Dock, from the next launch. Opening files from the right-click menu still shows it.

nativeNotifications.label: Native notifications
nativeNotifications.hint: Show a system notification when a batch finishes, fails or needs your attention while Pluryprint is in the background.

defaultProfile.label: Default profile
defaultProfile.hint: Applied to a job when no other profile is chosen.

printing.shellNote: The installer adds Pluryprint to the Explorer right-click menu: on Windows 11 it is under Show more options (or Shift+F10), on Windows 10 in the menu itself.
printing.shellNoteMac: Right-click printing works from Finder › Services › Print with Pluryprint. Those menu titles follow the system language.

concurrency.label: Concurrent conversions
concurrency.hint: Applies to the next conversion, no restart needed.

timeout.label: Conversion timeout
timeout.hint: 0 disables the timeout. Applies to the next conversion.

printTimeout.label: Print timeout
printTimeout.hint: 0 disables it. Counts from sending the file until the printer finishes the job.

maxFileSize.label: Max file size
maxFileSize.hint: Largest input accepted for printing. Applies immediately.

engine.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
engine.rangeOrZero: Enter 0, or a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

updates.channelNote: Stable receives final releases only. Beta also receives every pre-release, and moves on to the stable release of the same version. No nightly builds are published, so Nightly follows the beta feed.

checkOnStartup.label: Check on startup
checkOnStartup.hint: Asks GitHub for the latest release 30 seconds after launch, at most once every 24 hours.

updates.startupNote: The launch-time check only reads the number of the latest published release; nothing about you or your documents is sent, and Pluryprint never installs anything on its own — it tells you, and installs only when you choose Install now on the About screen. Turn it off and no request is made at launch; you can still check whenever you like from the About screen.

crashReports.label: Crash reports
crashReports.hint: Off by default. Nothing is sent in this version.

usageMetrics.label: Anonymous usage metrics
usageMetrics.hint: Pluryprint never enables this without consent.

privacy.note: No data is sent in this version — these switches record consent only.

status.unavailable: Settings below are read from the desktop app. In this preview only appearance is adjustable.

config.corruptTitle: Your settings file could not be read
config.corruptBody: The values below are the defaults, not your saved settings, and changes cannot be saved until the file is fixed or removed. Close Pluryprint, then repair or delete this file — a new one is written from the defaults on the next save.
